Title: Test Architecture and Benchmark Suite
Content: MemorySmith.Tests uses NUnit 4 with Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing for integration tests. All tests targeting file-backed services use isolated temp directories (Path.GetTempPath() + guid) created in SetUp and deleted in TearDown. ProjectWikiFixture.CopyToTemp copies Data/Memories into a temp location and returns the path; the fixture automatically finds the repo root via .slnx presence. TestServiceFactory.CreateMemoryApplicationService builds a MemoryApplicationService directly with an empty MemoryIndex (no pre-loading needed since SearchAsync uses store.LoadAll and Lucene token scoring in-process). RecordingEventStore and RecordingMemoryChangePublisher are in-memory stubs defined in MemoryApplicationServiceTests.cs. PagesAndChatTests covers page rendering/assets, attachments, provider metadata, usage, full-memory context hydration, and the app-intercepted chat tool loop; MemoryChatAgent_ExecutesInterceptedToolCallsBeforeReturningReply and MemoryChatAgent_StreamsToolCallStatusWithoutLeakingToolJson prove toolCalls JSON and JSON-RPC tools/call payloads run local wiki tools before the final answer without leaking tool JSON. SearchBenchmarkTests (Category=Benchmark) exercises lexical, semantic, and hybrid search modes with SearchProbe records defining query/expected-id/maxMs thresholds. The suite now includes chat/search dogfooding probes for model-used metadata, Stop generation cancellation, compact chat history, context-window usage/rate-limit display, intercepted MCP/wiki tool calls, GitHub model unavailable/auth guidance, Claude Haiku before Sonnet preference terms, and Ctrl+V copied-image paste terms. Lexical probes use MustContainId for ranking flexibility; semantic and hybrid probes can use TopId for ordering assertions. MemoryApplicationServiceTests includes a hyphenated query case proving SearchAsync uses Lucene lexical tokens rather than simple substring Contains. ServiceFactory in SearchBenchmarkTests uses BackgroundServiceTelemetryTracker (concrete class, no interface). The MCP integration tests use WebApplicationFactory<Program> with in-memory config overriding DataPath/EventLogPath/Maintenance:Enabled=false. app.css is maintained in wwwroot/app.css with focused edits to the relevant selectors.
